title: Import an account statement while skipping its trailing summary rows
steps: Change `Skip end lines` from 0 to 2 in the configured CSV import.

video_guide.summary: Skipping the two footer rows preserves the chosen field mappings, date format, Flip amount, and the three interpreted transactions.

chapters.note: The preview includes three transactions and two summary rows with the configured import settings.
Skip end lines is 2; only the three transactions remain, with their dates and amounts intact.
Date still uses Posting, Amount uses Value, DD.MM.YYYY remains selected, and Flip amount stays checked.
